title: Cookies
description: We use cookies to make your experience even better!
mainDescription: We use cookies to enhance your experience on the Boat4You platform, analyze how you use our website, and improve our boat booking system. These cookies help us deliver personalized content and ensure our platform works optimally for your booking needs. We collect essential cookies for platform functionality, analytics data to improve user experience, and preferences to personalize your dashboard. Learn more about our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.

necessary.title: Essential Cookies
necessary.description: These cookies and this browser storage are needed for the website to work and cannot be switched off: form security, language, basic navigation and keeping your chat open across pages. You can block cookies in your browser, but some parts of the website may then not work.

cookies.name: b4y_chat_token
cookies.duration: Until you clear your browser data
cookies.description: Keeps your chat with Iris open across pages. Created when you start a chat or when our team writes to you.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.description: With your consent we use Google Analytics and our own visit statistics: which pages you visit, what you click, how you found us, your country (from your IP address) and your device and browser. If you chat with Iris or our team, we link your visit to the chat so we can help you faster. Page views and clicks are kept on our servers in the EU for 13 months, visit details for 24 months, and the full IP address is deleted after 90 days. You can change your choice at any time in Cookies Settings.

cookies.name: _ga
cookies.description: Google Analytics cookie that tells visits apart and collects data about traffic and interactions on the website, to help us improve it.

cookies.name: b4y_cc_v
cookies.description: Visitor ID for our own visit statistics. Only with Analytics consent.

cookies.name: b4y_cc_s
cookies.description: The current visit, so that Iris greets you only once. Only with Analytics consent.

cookies.name: b4y_cc_cch
cookies.description: One-time code that links your visit from one of our sister sites to Boat4You. Only with Analytics consent.

marketing.title: Marketing Cookies
marketing.description: These cookies help us understand our marketing effectiveness and identify potential customers interested in our boat rental platform. We use them to track website interactions and improve our outreach to customers seeking yacht charter services. These cookies are only loaded with your consent and you can withdraw consent at any time.
